review_snapshot.rule: This disposition is valid only while the Current node-shard manifest retains the same canonical row digest. Any Source change reopens compact review instead of silently inheriting an old approval.

review_rule: Record reviewed Source/Knowledge dispositions without rewriting canonical OCR truth. Chengfeng remains the learner mainline. Suyi is background cross-check only; admit a delta only when it adds stable stage, turning-point, causal, evaluation or historical-position value missing from Current.

root_ocr_review.boundary: Observed source_bound_ocr_needs_review rows in the History scan are local child table/item/example OCR or layout defects. They do not make a declared Natural Unit owner unresolved and do not justify manufacturing whole-subject Source debt. Any future Source snapshot change reopens the compact queue.
